# hosttracker_monitor_types (Data Source)

The monitor-type catalogue: what each type is called, what it costs in entitlements, and what interval floor it enforces. `account_limits` is filled in for the configured token's account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hosttracker_monitor_types" "all" {}

# The interval floor this account may use for http monitors, which is the
# larger of the type's own floor and what the package sells.
locals {
  http_type = one([for t in data.hosttracker_monitor_types.all.types : t if t.type == "http"])
}

output "http_min_interval" {
  value = local.http_type.account_limits.min_interval
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `types` (Attributes List) One row per monitor type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--types))

<a id="nestedatt--types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `types`

Read-Only:

- `account_limits` (Attributes) The calling account's own limits for this type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--types--account_limits))
- `attachable` (Boolean) Whether this type can also ride on a parent monitor as a sub-check.
- `attachable_to` (List of String) The parent types this sub-check attaches to.
- `creatable` (Boolean) Whether a monitor of this type can be created.
- `entitlement` (String) The package entitlement gating the type, if any.
- `fixed_interval` (Number) The cadence this type is pinned to, in seconds, for the types the service schedules itself.
- `label` (String) The human name.
- `min_interval` (Number) The type's interval floor, in seconds.
- `presets` (List of String) Server-built settings presets this type publishes.
- `requires_pool` (Boolean) Whether a create is refused without `locations.pools`.
- `type` (String) The type token, as `type` on a monitor takes it.

<a id="nestedatt--types--account_limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `types.account_limits`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) False when the account's package does not sell this type at all.
- `min_interval` (Number) The account's effective interval floor for the type, in seconds.
